scope: M493 complete nine-source-file API candidate, API/DTO contracts, source dependencies and one-method StudioAPI proposal; no UI re-review or product execution.

sourceChecks.result: Exact one-argument Promise method. Descriptor-safe copy precedes original validateProfile. Proxies, accessors, hidden/symbol/unknown top-level fields, cycles, custom prototypes, sparse/oversized arrays and non-data values are rejected without invoking request getters. Only explicit optional undefined fields are omitted. Client-derived facts/source/session fields are not accepted.

Each request calls both complete fixed-source loaders, not constructor caches. Loaders hash fixed manifest bytes, original/rule/license file bytes and aggregate maps. Preview requires expected monthly source/revision, actual 庚-巳 clause and lunar source, then compares quote, locator and quote/context span bounds to the r4 paragraph. DTO keeps scanCollation:false and no broader source-authority claim.

Private fact construction uses raw pillars. Applicability requires known 庚 day and 巳 month; a known exclusion is decisive, otherwise missing prerequisites stay insufficient-data. Observations distinguish seen/not-seen/unknown. matched is only clause applicability; reference set is unranked, selectionStatus remains unknown, no completed useful-god or certificate result is created.

Fresh unchanged engine output supplies pillar facts; missing pillars become explicit unknownPositions. Unknown hour never gains a synthetic time pillar; unknown-hour month-boundary uncertainty removes the month pillar in the original engine. Cross-day uncertain trace removes day/time pillars and suspends favorable candidates in the original engine. Wrapper preserves analysis and trace without substitution. Saved absence remains not-recorded; present history is returned only as recorded-unverified by the separate helper, and preview never reads a saved session.

New preview path accesses only store.dataDir. Optional parentNameReadings follows the existing synchronous fixed-source validation adapter; its Worker query callback is not called by validateProfile. No customer rows/settings/SQL/writer/session reads or writes are introduced. Service adapter memoization is separate from customer Store data.

New IPC method uses existing register wrapper, preserving sender equality and desktop-phase guard before Service; existing notice scope/Promise delivery is retained. Preload adds only the exact Promise invocation and standalone API type intersection.

Browser method and allowlist are both delivered. POST, local-request header and origin guard, UTF-8 decoding, request budget, argument-array check, existing notice wrapper and HTTP400 error mapping are unchanged. Only the allowlist/method entry and type intersection are added.

Standalone DTO/method imports resolve against candidate+C097 dependencies. Shared DTO type imports add no runtime Node dependency to renderer consumers. Proposal adds only previewGengSiReference to root-owned StudioAPI and passes git apply --check on C097. No saved DTO field or shared/types candidate replacement is supplied.
